crater_water.setting.enabled.tooltip: Enable realistic volumetric water simulation for player-perturbed water.
crater_water.setting.mode.tooltip: Finite conserves total water volume; Spring lets player-placed water fill craters up to source height.
crater_water.setting.max_updates_per_tic: Maximum active water cells simulated per server tick to protect TPS.
crater_water.setting.spring_max_blocks.t: Maximum water blocks a spring can generate before stopping to prevent flooding the world.
crater_water.setting.flow_interval_ticks: Number of server ticks between simulation steps (lower is faster).
